findings: startingOld_triple_eq identifies the complete OrderedBoundaryTransport triple with oldTriple by all three coordinates. The old section skips B. The equality is not inferred from an endpoint-only comparison and does not presuppose that a composition gate has been transported.

startingTail_ne_A follows from the actual Fin.succAbove section that skips A. Applying this fact separately to lower, middle and upper excludes occurrence of A and therefore excludes containing both A and B. This works whether s is an endpoint or an interior core position and whether the core triple contains s.

collapse_startingTail_triple uses collapse_startingTail for each of the three positions, then triple_ext. Strictness is carried by the actual order embedding and by collapseTriple’s established sole-equality-exception argument. Any plainness proof gives the same exact core triple; the proof parameter is not a caller-supplied geometric or array identity.

tripleLift_startingOld invokes the exact old-triple identification and the frozen plain-array pullback theorem. tripleLift_startingTail first derives actual tail plainness and then collapses the whole triple. Both conclusions are H0 T for arbitrary result type and arbitrary exceptional data t, so no arithmetic, invertibility, sign-square or nonzero assumption is hidden.

These are the concrete evaluations required by the printed starting paragraph: row-zero near and far gates may use old images; row-one inherited near gates use the tail image because its first endpoint is B, while inherited far gates must use the old image because the full top interval still starts at A. The present body proves evaluation for either actual image but does not itself identify which image equals each actual cut gate; that is a separate StartingGatePositions obligation.

The domain contains the source’s n≥3 case with arbitrary distinguished s and does not impose n≥4 or any interval/composition nonemptiness premise. The helper is independent of the number of cuts, so its use does not discard the unary composition or a zero product. It is not a theorem about the exceptional newborn gate containing both A and B.
